name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
purpose: Two to five short options of which exactly one is chosen, shown side by side.
whenToUse: To switch how the same content is shown, such as a unified or a split diff.
To filter a list by one of a few values, such as the status of a run.
When every option has a label of one or two words and all of them should stay visible.
whenNotToUse: For more than five options, or labels longer than two words. Use a select or a radio group.
To move between views or pages. Use links, or the tab bar for an app's main destinations.
For a single on-or-off setting. Use a switch.
For actions, such as Rerun failed and Rerun all. Use an attached button group.
accessibility: Use a fieldset with gw-segmented-control and a legend with gw-segmented-control__legend that names the choice. Add gw-visually-hidden to the legend where a heading beside the control already names it. The legend stays in the markup.

Inside a div with gw-segmented-control__options, each option is a label with gw-segmented-control__option holding input type="radio" with gw-segmented-control__input and then a span with gw-segmented-control__label. The label element names the radio, and the span must come straight after the input.
Every input has the same name attribute, different from every other group on the page, and one input has the checked attribute from the start.
It needs no script: the browser keeps exactly one option chosen. An app that reacts at once listens for the change event on the fieldset.
The chosen option is a raised segment with a border and heavier text, so it does not rest on colour.
Disable one option with the disabled attribute on its input, or the whole control with disabled on the fieldset.
Tab moves into the control, to the chosen option. The arrow keys move between options and choose as they go. All of it comes from the native radios.

Each segment is at least 44px wide and its pointer target is 44px tall. The segments share the row equally at every width, and a label too long for its segment wraps inside it, so the control never scrolls sideways.
